comment: 基于非凡资源(苹果CMS)API的视频书源 v3。要点：bookUrl 用 {$.字段} 内嵌规则(JSON模式下由AnalyzeByJSonPath解析)；目录JS返回JSON字符串条目(避免Rhino对象上$.规则失效)；正文JS提取m3u8并用字符串拼接补全域名(Rhino无URL API)。

ruleToc.chapterList:
<js>
var v = JSON.parse(result).list[0];
var lines = (v.vod_play_url || '').split('$$$');
var line = lines[0] || '';
for (var i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
  if (lines[i].indexOf('m3u8') >= 0 || lines[i].indexOf('plays.com') >= 0) { line = lines[i]; break; }
}
var eps = line.split('#');
var out = [];
for (var j = 0; j < eps.length; j++) {
  var e = eps[j];
  var p = e.lastIndexOf('$');
  if (p < 0) continue;
  var nm = e.substring(0, p).replace(/^\s+|\s+$/g, '');
  var ul = e.substring(p + 1).replace(/^\s+|\s+$/g, '');
  if (nm && ul) out.push(JSON.stringify({ name: nm, url: ul }));
}
out;
</js>
